revisions.goal: Implement the opt-in macOS-hosted EVE Approvals PWA for iPhone, using Tailscale Serve for private authenticated access and direct standards-based Web Push for plan notifications.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: `eve phone setup/status/disable/reset` manage Tailscale Serve and a macOS LaunchAgent safely; remote requests enforce exact host, same Tailscale identity, HTTPS and same-origin mutations; phone APIs manage Apple Web Push subscriptions and test notifications without leaking secrets; runtime delivers deduplicated pending-plan notifications with retries; `/phone` and `/phone/plans/:id` provide install, queue, edit, approve and reject workflows; PWA manifest/service worker/icons are embedded; existing desktop plan UI remains functional; automated Go and UI verification passes; physical iPhone-only validation is documented if unavailable.

milestones.title: Host foundation
milestones.goal: Implement phone configuration, Tailscale discovery/Serve setup, LaunchAgent management, CLI lifecycle, and request security.

milestones.title: Push delivery
milestones.goal: Implement phone APIs, VAPID subscriptions, runtime reconciliation, delivery deduplication, retry handling, and diagnostics.

milestones.title: Phone PWA
milestones.goal: Implement focused onboarding, queue, plan review/edit/approve/reject, manifest, icons, service worker, and shared plan-review logic.

milestones.title: Validation and history
milestones.goal: Run automated and visual verification, commit implementation, complete the EVE snapshot, and commit the generated product record.
